entities.summary: Johannes "Hanns" Evangelist Hörbiger was an Austrian engineer from Vienna with roots in Tyrol. He took part in the construction of the Budapest subway and in 1894 invented a new type of valve essential for compressors still in widespread use today.

entities.name: Hanns Hörbiger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes "Hanns" Evangelist Hörbiger was an Austrian engineer from Vienna with roots in Tyrol. He took part in the construction of the Budapest subway and in 1894 invented a new type of valve essential for compressors still in widespread use today.
